decisions.reason: Waiting for missing parts before placing the combined order does not change the required BOM contents or board-specific BOM obligation.
The order-grouping decision does not alter the requirement to validate component orientations in JLCPCB.
Adding the sensor-board order after parts become available does not change the required production export file set.
The message specifies when to place the sensor-board order, not a change to component-selection or long-term sourceability rules.
Manufacturing-order timing and grouping do not affect connector pin-label markings.
The source decision does not change the interboard power topology, connectors, or pinout requirements.
The combined manufacturing order has no effect on the required 3.3V and 5V current-monitoring behavior.
The timing of the sensor-board order does not modify connector placement, alignment, orientation, or cable-routing constraints.
The source message concerns procurement sequencing and does not resolve or modify standalone USB power behavior or regulator capacity.
Adding the sensor board to the manufacturing order does not alter its connector-hub role or connector matrix.
In this order-configuration context, '4th (sensor)' identifies an additional order entry and does not necessarily redefine the established three-board product architecture.
The sensor-board ordering condition does not change the requirement that all required components and connectors fit on the board.
